# Kelp: a 2.7 m stalk of six stacked 5-sided segments with five blades alternating sides, skinned
# to a 3-bone chain (auto weights: the bend is shared smoothly between neighbouring bones). The sway is
# a 4 s loop (48 frames at 12 fps): each bone leans on a small circle, more towards the tip, keys every
# 6 frames, linear (constant speed round the loop), last key = first. Instances in the scene get
# their own `phase`. Up Z. Written by hand (the keys from sin/cos, listed below).
new
fps 12
frame range 0 48
material new Stalk --base-color 0.0 0.373 0.549 --no-slot
material new Blade --base-color 0.0 0.725 0.745 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name S0 --vertices 5 --radius 0.090 --depth 0.47 --location -0.04 0 0.225
material assign Stalk
add mesh cylinder --name S1 --vertices 5 --radius 0.082 --depth 0.47 --location 0.04 0 0.675
material assign Stalk
add mesh cylinder --name S2 --vertices 5 --radius 0.074 --depth 0.47 --location -0.04 0 1.125
material assign Stalk
add mesh cylinder --name S3 --vertices 5 --radius 0.066 --depth 0.47 --location 0.04 0 1.575
material assign Stalk
add mesh cylinder --name S4 --vertices 5 --radius 0.058 --depth 0.47 --location -0.04 0 2.025
material assign Stalk
add mesh cylinder --name S5 --vertices 5 --radius 0.050 --depth 0.47 --location 0.04 0 2.475
material assign Stalk
add mesh cube --name B0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.7 0.28 0.05
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
translate 0.33 0 0
select vert where "pos.x > 0.5"
scale 1 0.5 1
translate 0 0 0.12
mode object
material assign Blade
set location 0 0 0.55
set rotation 0 -28 0
apply --location --rotation
add mesh cube --name B1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.7 0.28 0.05
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
translate 0.33 0 0
select vert where "pos.x > 0.5"
scale 1 0.5 1
translate 0 0 0.12
mode object
material assign Blade
set location 0 0 1.0
set rotation 0 -28 215
apply --location --rotation
add mesh cube --name B2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.7 0.28 0.05
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
translate 0.33 0 0
select vert where "pos.x > 0.5"
scale 1 0.5 1
translate 0 0 0.12
mode object
material assign Blade
set location 0 0 1.45
set rotation 0 -28 70
apply --location --rotation
add mesh cube --name B3 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.7 0.28 0.05
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
translate 0.33 0 0
select vert where "pos.x > 0.5"
scale 1 0.5 1
translate 0 0 0.12
mode object
material assign Blade
set location 0 0 1.9
set rotation 0 -28 285
apply --location --rotation
add mesh cube --name B4 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.7 0.28 0.05
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
translate 0.33 0 0
select vert where "pos.x > 0.5"
scale 1 0.5 1
translate 0 0 0.12
mode object
material assign Blade
set location 0 0 2.35
set rotation 0 -28 140
apply --location --rotation
select S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 B0 B1 B2 B3 B4
active S0
join
rename S0 Kelp
apply
add armature --name Rig --location 0 0 0
mode edit
bone select all
bone delete
bone add K0 --head 0 0 0 --tail 0 0 0.9
bone add K1 --head 0 0 0.9 --tail 0 0 1.8 --parent K0 --connected
bone add K2 --head 0 0 1.8 --tail 0 0 2.75 --parent K1 --connected
mode object
select Kelp Rig
parent set Rig --type armature --auto-weights
active Rig
mode pose
pose select all
frame set 0
pose set K0 rotation 0.00 4.80 0
pose set K1 rotation 0.00 8.40 0
pose set K2 rotation 0.00 12.00 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 6
pose set K0 rotation 5.66 3.39 0
pose set K1 rotation 9.90 5.94 0
pose set K2 rotation 14.14 8.49 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 12
pose set K0 rotation 8.00 0.00 0
pose set K1 rotation 14.00 0.00 0
pose set K2 rotation 20.00 0.00 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 18
pose set K0 rotation 5.66 -3.39 0
pose set K1 rotation 9.90 -5.94 0
pose set K2 rotation 14.14 -8.49 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 24
pose set K0 rotation 0.00 -4.80 0
pose set K1 rotation 0.00 -8.40 0
pose set K2 rotation 0.00 -12.00 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 30
pose set K0 rotation -5.66 -3.39 0
pose set K1 rotation -9.90 -5.94 0
pose set K2 rotation -14.14 -8.49 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 36
pose set K0 rotation -8.00 -0.00 0
pose set K1 rotation -14.00 -0.00 0
pose set K2 rotation -20.00 -0.00 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 42
pose set K0 rotation -5.66 3.39 0
pose set K1 rotation -9.90 5.94 0
pose set K2 rotation -14.14 8.49 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 48
pose set K0 rotation -0.00 4.80 0
pose set K1 rotation -0.00 8.40 0
pose set K2 rotation -0.00 12.00 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
keyframe interpolation linear --all
action rename RigAction Sway
frame set 0
mode object
select all
shade flat
export kelp.glb --bake-animations
